attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is enumerated — twenty-seven men named one by one, with patronymics, birthplaces and the months of their deaths — so it is twenty-seven folders and not one, by docs/CORPUS.md §10.1. Nothing in the corpus answers to any of these surnames: a grep of `saints/` for all twenty-seven returned nothing, and no folder mentions Kharkov except `meletius-of-kharkov`, a bishop of the eighteen-hundreds. His own head line reads «Αγιος Ιωαννης ο Ιερομαρτυς (; - 1937)», and his sentence in the page's list is quoted whole in the life. The page spells his surname «Θεοντόρωφ» and that of the deacon of Krasnokutsk «Θέντοροφ»; the two are separate entries with separate years, and the display name keeps the province the page gives him so that they can be told apart.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Ιερομάρτυς Ιωάννης Πέτροβιτς Θεοντόρωφ, ο οποίος γεννήθηκε στο χωριό Σεσλαβίνο της επαρχίας του Ταμπώφ και μαρτύρησε τον Αύγουστο του 1937.»
